title: docs(skills): clear the GraphQL residue from the published catalog and declare sharingModel on its four object examples
body:
Fixes #10846
Fixes #10925

Two cards on the published skills catalog, one commit each. Both are corrections to
`skills/**` — the customer/AI-facing surface — so the whole PR is GOVERNED: draft, human
merge, no auto-merge, no enqueue.

## Commit 1 — #10846: five GraphQL residue sites + the mirror

`/graphql` is not mounted. Re-verified at fix time against `origin/main` afe1c4e0a, not
taken from the card:

- `packages/runtime/src/http-dispatcher.ts:2069` — `// /graphql removed — GraphQL is not in the product plan (#2462 follow-on).`
- 0 hits for `createGraphQLDomain` under `packages/*/src`; `handleGraphQL` survives only in CHANGELOGs
- `packages/spec/src/system/core-services.zod.ts:130-132` independently records that `graphql` was never a `CoreServiceName`

| Site | Fix |
|:---|:---|
| `skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md` tags | dropped `graphql` — the description one line above already lists no GraphQL surface |
| `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` `apiEnabled` | REST + MCP, the two surfaces the flag actually gates (`packages/mcp/src/stdio-data-bridge.ts:260` reads `enable.apiEnabled === false`) |
| `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` mount line | `createHonoApp` mounts auth and discovery only |
| `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md` `GraphQL.ComputedField` row | deleted |
| `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md` `api/graphql` cache-key row | deleted |

**The `/storage` half of the platform line was verified before touching**, as the card
asked, and the card is right — so it is corrected in the same edit, same line, same defect
class: `packages/adapters/hono/src/index.ts:423` is `// --- Storage: deliberately NOT
mounted (#4087) ---`, and the dispatcher carries the matching `No /storage domain (#4087)`
note. `service-storage` mounts its own surface.

**Deletion rather than replacement** on the two formula rows: nothing real fills either
slot. The computed-field CEL host is already the `Field` / `type: 'formula'` row above it,
and no cache-key template surface exists — `system/cache` takes plain key patterns and
`api/http-cache.zod.ts` has no key or template member at all.

The mirror row in `content/docs/ai/skills-reference.mdx` moves in this same commit, per the
card's anti-drift requirement. Rows naming GraphQL as a general industry concept were left
alone (the card's not-in-scope note); after this commit `skills/**` has zero GraphQL hits.

## Commit 2 — #10925: four `sharingModel` declarations, then the gate root

The 4 `ObjectSchema.create()` examples omitted `sharingModel` — type-checks clean, while
`os validate` rejects it as severity `error` (`SECURITY_OWD_UNSET`).

| Site | Value | Mirrored or defaulted |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `objectstack-data` `account` | `'private'` | **defaulted** |
| `objectstack-data` `invoice` | `'private'` | **defaulted** |
| `objectstack-data` `support_case` | `'private'` | **defaulted** |
| `objectstack-upgrade` `crm_lead` | `'public_read_write'` | **mirrored** |

`examples/` carries no object named `account`, `invoice` or `support_case`. The showcase
app's `showcase_account` / `showcase_invoice` are differently-named objects, and their
`public_read_write` is an explicit ADR-0090 D1 grandfather stamp — the source comment reads
"record isolation for this demo object is RLS-owned / intentionally public". A demo's
stamp is not a value to teach, so those three take the rule's own recommended default.

`crm_lead` is the one exact name match: `examples/app-crm/src/objects/lead.object.ts` is
`name: 'crm_lead'`, so the skill and the app disagreeing about one object's OWD would be
real drift. ⚠️ **Reviewer call worth making explicitly**: that value is itself a demo
grandfather stamp, so mirroring it teaches `public_read_write` in the upgrade skill. The
alternative (`'private'`, consistent with the other three) trades app-consistency for a
safer taught default. Flagged rather than decided. **Resolved 2026-08-23** — the
maintainer ruled, of the two options put to them (verbatim): 「镜像 public_read_write（推荐）」.
The mirrored value stands; no diff change.

Only then the gate half. `check-doc-security-posture` grows the `skills/` root its own
header recorded as deferred, following `check-skill-examples.ts`'s `SOURCE_ROOTS`
two-root/two-marker shape (`.md` + `<!-- os:check -->`; `.mdx` keeps the MDX comment
spelling, since fumadocs-mdx fails the build outright on HTML comments). Sequencing is the
point — extending the roots first would have made the gate born red.

Two holes the generalization could have opened, closed in the same commit:

- the anti-idle floor is now **per root** (a root scanned with the wrong marker reads zero
  blocks, and one whole-corpus counter would have stayed green on the other root's census
  while a governed corpus went unjudged);
- an exemption entry belonging to no root would be dropped by the per-root routing and
  never judged stale, silently ending the ledger's self-invalidating discipline — now a
  loud refusal.

## `check:skills-token-ratchet` — was RED, cleared by maintainer ruling (2026-08-23)

> **Maintainer ruling, 2026-08-23, on this PR** (verbatim, of the three options put to
> them — A raise the ceilings / B fund by prose deletion / C land commit 1 alone):
> 「A：提天花板（推荐）」
>
> Executed as commit `c41928cb7`: `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` ceilings
> `objectstack-data` 13797→13817, `objectstack-upgrade` 8325→8335, each annotated with
> the ruling date and this PR. Gate + its 33-case self-test green at that commit —
> `✓ check-skills-token-ratchet: 11 published SKILL.md within their ceilings.`

What was red, kept for the record:

```
✗ check-skills-token-ratchet: skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md is 13817 tokens; the ratchet ceiling is 13797 (over by 20).
✗ check-skills-token-ratchet: skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md is 8335 tokens; the ratchet ceiling is 8325 (over by 10).
```

Every ceiling in the catalog sat at **exactly zero headroom** before this PR. The four
`sharingModel` lines are required by a gating-tier security rule, and they cost 30 tokens
across two files that have nowhere to put them. The gate names the only two remedies, and
both are marked `⛔ MAINTAINER-ONLY`: delete text in the same file, or raise the ceiling in
a PR quoting a maintainer ruling.

The author took neither remedy unilaterally — deleting published-catalog prose to fund a
fix is an editorial call on the surface the maintainer ruled the platform's highest-value
one, and raising a ceiling is explicitly not an author's step. The ruling above is what
authorizes the raise.

Worth weighing, because the per-file unit hides it: **the bundle as a whole grows by 3
tokens.** Commit 1's residue deletions pay back 27 of the 30 — they just land in the wrong
files.

```
   skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md            6346 /   6348   (-2)
   skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md          13817 /  13797   (+20)
   skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md        6036 /   6055   (-19)
   skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md      12710 /  12716   (-6)
   skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md        8335 /   8325   (+10)
   bundle total                             117922 / 117919   (+3)
```

(**Commit 1 is clean on its own** — it only shrinks, -27 tokens — and was the fallback
option C; the ruling made splitting unnecessary.)

## Value-density readings (`skills/**` governed-surface requirement)

Whole-file, before → after:

| File | Lines | Tokens (`ceil(utf8 bytes / 4)`) |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `objectstack-api/SKILL.md` | 610 → 610 (0) | 6348 → 6346 (-2) |
| `objectstack-data/SKILL.md` | 1207 → 1210 (+3) | 13797 → 13817 (+20) |
| `objectstack-formula/SKILL.md` | 556 → 554 (-2) | 6055 → 6036 (-19) |
| `objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` | 1286 → 1286 (0) | 12716 → 12710 (-6) |
| `objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md` | 695 → 696 (+1) | 8325 → 8335 (+10) |

Whole package (all 11 published SKILL.md): **10504 → 10506 lines (+2)**, **117919 → 117922
tokens (+3)**. No prose was expanded; every addition is a required schema key and every
deletion is a removed-surface assertion.

## Verification

Gates derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` (no hand-fed paths) at the final
commit `e87585fa5`, then run — 25 families, **24 green, 1 red** (the ratchet above).

```
✅ 26 ObjectSchema.create example(s) in 227 marked block(s) across 237 prose file(s) in 2 root(s) carry an os validate-clean security posture
   docs     22 create site(s) in 191 marked block(s) across 189 .mdx file(s)
   skills    4 create site(s) in  36 marked block(s) across 48 .md file(s)
```

```
✓ doc authoring guard: 389 files clean — no bare metadata literals.
  check:role-word — Scanned: 225 .md/.mdx file(s) read across 2 root(s) — content/docs 189, skills 36.
✓ check-skill-compatibility-version: 11 SKILL.md file(s) reconciled against 78 workspace packages
✓ check-skill-frame-sync: 4 copies of the decision frame are structurally isomorphic across 3 files
check-nul-bytes: OK (scanned 6447 text file(s) ...; no raw ASCII control bytes).
```

Also green: `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `doc-anchors`, `doc-frontmatter`,
`docs-audit-scope`, `docs-redirects`, `published-readme-links`, `pm-governed-merges`,
`cross-package-test-inputs`, `slot-lookup`, `test-source-alias`, `type-source-resolution`,
`ci-filter-parity`, `plugin-teardown-shape`, `affected-docs`, and the four
`spec-liveness-check` families.

**Reverse-verification of the extended gate** (from the committed state, restore proven on
disk): re-removing the `support_case` `sharingModel` took the gate red at exactly that
site —

```
skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md:323  object "support_case"  [security-owd-unset]
```

and restoring returned it to the green census above. The mutation was confirmed on disk
before the run (`sharingModel` count 3 → 2 plus the site read back), not inferred from the
editor's exit code. Noting one real stumble for the record: the restore trap fired with the
wrong working directory and printed a false "RESTORED" over a `pathspec did not match`
error — caught by re-reading `git status`, and the tree was restored by hand and
re-verified byte-identical before anything else ran.

## No changeset

`packages/lint`'s published `files` is `["dist","README.md","CHANGELOG.md"]`, with no `bin`
and dist-only `exports` — `scripts/**` ships to no consumer. This PR touches no package
`src/`, so no published artifact changes and nothing releases. Declared with
`skip-changeset` rather than an empty-frontmatter changeset, which
`scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs` rejects outright.

## Out of scope, filed not fixed

#11140 — the same GraphQL residue class two sites further in, in package SOURCE comments
(`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts:252`, `packages/adapters/hono/src/index.ts:105-106`).
The hono JSDoc is the likely origin of the stale platform-skill line this PR fixes,
`/storage` included. Left out deliberately: different surface, different gate family, and
folding it in would be unreviewable scope creep on a governed diff.
